The '''Skilla''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]. Their vital organs,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> including [[Eye|photosensitive orbs]] for sight, [[Ear|vibrating cilia]] for hearing, and [[Nose|smell receptors]], lined an uvula-like bulb suspended from the roof of their [[mouth]],<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> behind rows of sharp [[Tooth|teeth]]. The [[bounty hunter]] [[Carib Diss]] was a Skilla<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> who had an unsettling appearance as a result of his species' biology and wore a [[sensor dome]] cap to gather data about his surroundings without needing to open his mouth.<ref name="TROS VD" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard_41.png|thumb|right|200px|Skilla concept art by Ivan Manzella]]
The Skilla first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> The species was designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]] under the title "Wizard 41".<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> The names of the Skilla and the first depicted member, Carib Diss, are tuckerizations of [[Wikipedia:Scylla|Scylla]] and [[Wikipedia:Charybdis|Charybdis]], a duo of sea monsters from Greek mythology.
